summary.zh: 评审 REST 接口改动，查规范与破坏性变更
summary.en: Review REST endpoint changes for conventions and breaking changes.

description.zh: 在合并或批准之前评审新增、变更的 REST 接口，检查命名与约定是否一致，标出会影响现有调用方的破坏性变更，并给出设计评分。适合接口 PR 和设计文档评审。评分脚本需要 Python 环境。
description.en: Reviews new or changed REST endpoints before merge: naming and conventions, changes that break existing callers, and a design score. Fits endpoint PRs and design docs. The scoring scripts need Python.
